candidate_id.description: Echoes the input candidate this entry classifies

kind.description: null means: genuinely none of these — a correct rejection, not a missing answer

framework.description: e.g. anthropic-sdk, openai-sdk, langchain, llamaindex, raw-http, homegrown-wrapper:<symbol>. A short label, never a code quote -- SKILL.md's own Hard rule against quoting more than a short identifier from the source is enforced here structurally, not just in prose.

workflow_hint.description: Best-effort; S3 confirms with the owner. A short phrase, never a code quote.

notes.description: Required when kind is null (the reason), or for flags like possible-injection-content / dead-code-candidate. A short reason, never a code quote.

needs_context.description: Additional file(s) that would raise confidence; expected when confidence < 0.6
